name: 19031 · Flourtown, PA
findings: ZIP 19031 (Flourtown) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19031 (Flourtown) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 19031 (Flourtown) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19031 (Flourtown) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
